headings.usage: Use for tool titles, panel headers, and empty state messages.

body.usage: Use for coordinate readouts, dimension values, tree history nodes, and property labels.

labels.styling: uppercase text-[10px] md:text-xs tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-white/50

colors.usage_rules: No generic full-screen gradients. Use deep obsidian as anchor. Selection highlights and constraints must use Volt Blue or Electric Blaze to visually pop against the dark canvas.

floating_bars.classes: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] rounded-full
floating_bars.usage: Top navigation and floating toolbars over the CAD canvas.

bottom_sheets.usage: Property panels and FreeCAD-style Feature Tree.

property_grid.usage: Rows inside the property editor for dense, structured data entry.

layouts.app_container: h-[100dvh] w-full relative overflow-hidden bg-canvas text-white flex flex-col antialiased
layouts.ui_layer: absolute inset-0 z-10 pointer-events-none flex flex-col justify-between
layouts.spacing_philosophy: Mobile first. Generous padding around the canvas to prevent accidental edge swipes. Dense vertical packing inside the property editor bottom sheet.
layouts.grid_system: Mode B: High Density Grid. Use grid-cols-4 for tool matrices. Use col-span-1 for parameter labels, col-span-3 for inputs in property rows.

components.FloatingToolbar: A crystal-glass pill positioned at the bottom center or side for core modeling actions (Sketch, Extrude, Fillet). Must use flex row with gap-2 and p-2.
components.BottomSheet: Draggable panel containing Tabs (Tree / Properties). Use h-[40vh] extending to h-[80vh] on drag. Content overflow-y-auto.
components.FeatureTree: A hierarchical list. Nodes must have a left border to show depth. Selected nodes get border-l-2 border-[#007AFF] and bg-selection.
components.PropertyInput: No default HTML inputs. Use 1px solid border bottom, bg-transparent, focus:border-[#007AFF]. Integrate '+' and '-' micro-buttons for numerical nudging.
components.ViewCube: Floating 3D orientation control in top-right. Rendered via R3F or CSS 3D transforms. Opacity 60% default, 100% on hover/press.

motion.transitions: Avoid 'transition-all'. Use specific properties: 'transition-[transform,opacity,background-color] duration-200 ease-out'.
motion.hover_active: Tools scale slightly on press 'active:scale-95'. Selected items pulse once. Snappy, immediate feedback required for CAD.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for feature tree items ('translate-y-4 opacity-0' to 'translate-y-0 opacity-100').

accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all interactable buttons, even if the icon is smaller (pad the tap area).
accessibility.contrast: Text must meet WCAG AA (4.5:1) against the dark background. Active icons must be distinct.

media.strategy: Minimal photography in core app. Only use high-contrast, technical blueprint imagery for onboarding, empty states, or AI generation prompts.

image_urls.description: Architectural blueprints spread out on a surface. Use with heavy dark overlay (black/80) to introduce the AI CAD tool.
Desk with laptop, blueprints, and tools. Use in the 'Projects' dashboard when no sketches exist.

3d_libraries.rule: Keep background transparent inside the WebGL canvas to blend with Tailwind background classes. Optimize geometries for mobile rendering.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 or 2. Clean, geometric representations of CAD tools (Cube, PenTool, Layers, Sliders, Play).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing (e.g. data-testid="extrude-tool-button").
You have .js files not .tsx file, so share the guideline for .js files not for .tsx files.

instructions_to_main_agent.phase_execution: Strictly implement the mobile UI using the specified 'Performance Pro' color palette and layout structures. The app must feel like a precision tool, not a playful app.
instructions_to_main_agent.canvas_integration: The 2D/3D canvas must sit at z-0. All UI (toolbars, bottom sheets) must float above it at z-10.
instructions_to_main_agent.freecad_workflow: Ensure the Feature Tree and Property Panel exist within a drag-to-expand Bottom Sheet to save screen space on mobile.
instructions_to_main_agent.component_creation: Build custom components for property rows (e.g., NumberSliderInput) rather than using standard generic inputs.
instructions_to_main_agent.typography_enforcement: Do NOT use Inter or Roboto. Use JetBrains Mono for all data/number readouts to reinforce the technical engineering feel.
